name: Breaking Boundaries
source:
This is a complete Ren'Py port of the comic  [url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/breaking-46255256]Breaking Boundaries[/url] from [url=https://vndb.org/p14121]Sneaky Bastard[/url].

Sneaky Bastard's signature silver fox, Harry, is in for the surprise of his life when he goes to rouse Liza. It seems that she's been waiting for him all night, and her intentions are less than innocent…

Sneaky Bastard delivers age play and richly detailed hardcore close-ups with this sensual, full dialogue, 63 image set! It's so hard to be loyal to one woman when you've got so much manly charm, but a quickie might turn into something much more if Harry isn't careful. Afterall, Liza can be a real handful, literally, figuratively, but in reality... much more.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/breaking-46255256]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
这是漫画 [url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/breaking-46255256]Breaking Boundaries[/url] 的完整Ren'Py移植，来自 [url=https://vndb.org/p14121]Sneaky Bastard[/url]。

当偷偷摸摸的混蛋的标志性银狐哈利去叫醒丽莎时，他将迎来一生中的惊喜。看来她已经等了他一整夜了，而且她的用意并不纯真……

Sneaky Bastard通过这套感性、完整的对话、63张图像集提供了年龄游戏和丰富细节的硬核特写镜头！当你拥有如此多的男子气概时，要忠于一个女人是非常困难的，但如果哈利不小心的话，一时的冲动可能会变得更加重要。毕竟，丽莎可能是一个真正的少数人，无论是字面上还是比喻上，但实际上……更多。

[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/breaking-46255256]Patreon[/url]]
